_help: All the website's words. Edit, then run: python3 Website/site.py build. Wrap words in ~~ ~~ to strike them through. Colours: yellow, cyan, green, red, magenta, grey.

typing._help: Characters a second. The app types at 36.

page.title: Vidiprinter+
page.description: Vidiprinter+ for iPhone: every goal, and every key statistic, the moment it happens. Live vidiprinter, live stats and alerts for your games.

hero.title: VIDIPRINTER
hero.tagline: Every goal, and every key statistic, the moment it happens.

features.label: GOAL
features.title: Every goal, the moment it goes in
lines: Goals, red cards, missed penalties, results, displayed as they happen.

features.label: STATS
features.title: More than the score
lines: The story behind the goal. Debuts, hat-tricks, scoring runs, droughts ended and season milestones, displayed as soon as they happen.
At full time: the result in context, comebacks, winning runs and table moves.

features.label: ALERTS
features.title: Never miss a moment
lines: Alerts for line-ups, kick-off, goals, red cards, missed penalties, half time and full time.
Vidiprinter+ supports push alerts, live activities and home screen widgets

features.label: NO SPOILERS
features.title: Keep games out of your feed
lines: Streaming, or watching your game on delay? Hide your club's matches from the vidiprinter feed so you never accidentally spoil the action.

features.label: MY CLUB
features.title: Your team, front and centre
lines: Follow as many clubs as you like.
Each one has its own page featuring detailed stats, results and fixtures.

features.label: TABLES
features.title: Standings, the way you want them
lines: Sort every league table by form, home and away record, goals for and against, xG, or between any two dates.

features.label: SHARE
features.title: Post the line, not a screenshot
lines: Any stat line becomes an image for sharing on social media.

features.label: NO ADS
features.title: Just the football
lines: No banners, no pop-ups, no betting promos. Nothing between you and the scores.

features.label: FT
features.title: Football, top to bottom
lines: From the Premier League to the National League North and South in England, Women's Super League, WSL 2 and domestic cups. Scottish Premiership to League Two, plus both cups.
Europe's top leagues and cups, MLS and the Saudi Pro League.

download.comingSoon: COMING SOON TO THE APP STORE
